benefits.text: The "Light Up Fitting" cream formula with light-reflecting ingredients helps catch the light and tone up the skin, while also helping makeup last longer. The light, fluid essence texture feels silky smooth on the skin and is not sticky. It also contains sea daffodil extract, from a flower that blooms only in the hottest part of summer, which helps deeply moisturize the skin, and high-molecular-weight organic UV filters with SPF 50+ PA++++ to protect your skin from the strongest UV rays

howToUse.text:
Step 1: Gently shake the bottle
Step 2: After skincare, dispense a few drops onto your hand and gently apply to the skin
Step 3: Spread evenly and gently pat in the product; an additional suitable amount can be added

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

sellingPoints.text: Light-reflecting Light Up Fitting; SPF50+ PA++++; light, fluid, silky-smooth, non-sticky texture.

texture.text: Light, fluid essence-type primer, silky smooth.

positioning.text: Light, fluid essence-type tone-up primer that helps catch the light, tone up and support longer-lasting makeup.

finish.text: Subtle tone-up / bright and smooth / glowy base.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it actually whitens skin or tones up permanently. SPF does not fully replace sunscreen during prolonged sun exposure.
